summary.text: Mike Lee (listed by Ballotpedia as Michael Lee) is a Democratic member of the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 50, who took office on November 5, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. His background includes youth leadership training, wrestling coaching and program facilitation.

paragraphs.text: Michael Lee graduated from Punahou School, earned a bachelor's degree from Pacific University, and earned a graduate degree in conflict resolution education and cultural competency from Portland State University.

His career experience includes serving as a volunteer wrestling coach, youth leadership trainer, program facilitator for the Hawaiʻi Chapter of Lions Club International, and Department of Education natural resource academy advisor.

As of his 2024 campaign, he served on the Kailua Neighborhood Board, the Windward Neighborhood Security Watch board, the Pali Lions Club board, the board of the Hawaiʻi Federation of USA Wrestling and the Paʻani Challenge board.
Lee succeeded Natalia Hussey-Burdick in District 50.
For 2025-2026 he serves on the Culture and Arts and Finance committees and is vice chair of the Labor Committee.
He advanced from the August 8, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed, and Green Party candidate Jesse Fitzgerald also advanced to the general election.
